# E0382: a lens writes a required field only under conditions the checker cannot show exhaustive

A required target field written only under conditions must be written under
conditions that together cover every instance. Here two of the three values
`k` can take are handled, so the checker cannot show the third is.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				k: "x" | "y" | "z"
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			if v0_0.k == "x" {
				a: "1"
			}
			if v0_0.k == "y" {
				a: "2"
			}
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			k: "x"
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0382]: a in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is not total for some instance
  --> lineage.cue:21:3
   |
21 |         v1_0: {
   |         ^^^^
   |
   = note: a in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is required by the target schema, and is written only under v0_0.k == "x"; v0_0.k == "y", which the checker cannot show cover every instance; write it unconditionally, under a condition and its negation, or under type tests covering every alternative of the tested field
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule unknown-exhaustive)
   = help: write the mapping in a form the checker can follow, or add a lacuna where it cannot decide
```
